fullGate.scope: Offline evaluation source plus accepted REC-01–05; no Dev/device/live/Production acceptance

focused.countsOverlapFullGate: Do not sum repeated focused/full runs.

syntheticServerRequests.qualification: InMemory and fake provider route checks, not real Auth/RLS/Storage or provider safety

credentialGatedApi.reason: Required Auth/Storage/database E2E environment is not configured; not counted as passed

openAcceptance: Supported image-byte/independent ground-truth pre-live freeze and current provider checklist
Authorized live feasibility/precision/recall/cost/retry/p95 and aggregate spend evidence
Exact Dev deployment and standalone physical iOS/Android text/photo/Keychain/restart/accessibility journeys
Separate adult pilot/product validation and Production/Store milestones

candidateScope.exclusions: Concurrent Community/cache/analytics/meal-copy/Coach/routine runtime, unrelated migrations and continuity; accepted REC-05 inherited unchanged

postGateDocumentation: Final receipt/report/manifest and continuity annotations are post-check records; targeted format/navigation/hash checks recorded in handoff-check-summary.txt.
